`getNodeParameters` no longer strips the leading `=` from a `$fromAI` placeholder on a field with `noDataExpression: true`. The placeholder (e.g. `={{ $fromAI('resource') }}`) now stays an expression, so the AI can still fill it in. The test file passes (185 tests), but the linter couldn't run here.

**Cause:** in `packages/workflow/src/node-helpers.ts`, `getNodeParameters` removes the `=` prefix from any expression on a `noDataExpression` field. For a `$fromAI` value, that turned the placeholder into literal text.

**Fix:** the strip is now skipped when the value contains `$fromAI(`. The match is case-insensitive, because the data proxy also accepts mis-capitalized `$fromAI`. Other expressions on these fields are still stripped as before.

**Test:** I added a test in `packages/workflow/test/node-helpers.test.ts` that checks a `$fromAI` value on a `noDataExpression` field comes back unchanged. I didn't run it against the unfixed code, so I haven't confirmed it fails without the change.

judge.reason: The regex skips stripping whenever $fromAI( appears anywhere in the value, so mixed expressions like a $fromAI() concatenated with other text or with an interpolated argument keep their '=' prefix, when only a lone $fromAI() placeholder should. The merged fix uses isFromAIOnlyExpression to restrict the carve-out, which the engineer's change does not do.
